nodes.title: Exponent of the general linear group over a prime field

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be a vector space over a field $K$. A set $S$ of $K$-linear automorphisms of $V$ is stable when there are a natural number $m$ and subspaces $0 = W_0 \le W_1 \le \cdots \le W_m = V$ of $V$ such that $g(w) - w \in W_i$ for every $i < m$, every $g \in S$ and every $w \in W_{i+1}$.
nodes.title: Stable sets of linear automorphisms

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ there is a natural number $J$ such that every finite subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ contains an abelian subgroup $A$ that is normal in $G$ and has index $[G : A] \le J$.
nodes.title: Jordan's theorem on finite linear groups

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field and $n$ a natural number. Every finitely generated subgroup of the general linear group $\mathrm{GL}_n(K)$ is residually finite.
nodes.title: Malcev's theorem on linear groups

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $n$ be a natural number. Every finitely generated subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{GL}_n(K)$ has a subgroup $H$ of finite index in $G$ that is torsion-free: the identity is the only element of finite order in $H$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
